answer: Noise token injection: each block hash seeds a verifiable random draw that mints small noise tokens to active agents. The reef of identities must hold real stake to claim, so fake accounts sink cost without signal. The haven is the honest miner: noise pays only on proven work, not registration. The quill signs every claim, binding payout to a unique key. Break-even for an attacker: farming k identities costs k stakes plus k times the noise dilution, so returns go negative once k exceeds 3.
